specification_source: inputs/SRS2_1.md (OR-SRS-SDS-2026-V2.1: Full Community, Dual-Screen Architecture & Club Governance)

stack.frontend: Next.js 15 (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons)
stack.design_system: Soft-Clay SaaS Architecture + 10 Functional Pairs (20 Dedicated Core Screens) + 6 Dedicated Portals
stack.test_runner: Jest + Headless Chrome CDP Real-DOM E2E

acceptance_criteria.story: Valid Standard Run Activity (US-ENG-01)
acceptance_criteria.given: A running activity with distance 5.2 km, moving time 1716 seconds (pace 5:30 min/km), elevation gain 40 m within race window
acceptance_criteria.when: evaluateActivity() is called with default rules
acceptance_criteria.then: Activity is valid (isValid=true) with finalDistanceKm=5.2 and bonusDistanceKm=0

acceptance_criteria.story: Distance Below Minimum Threshold (US-ENG-02)
acceptance_criteria.given: A running activity with distance 2.8 km (below minDistanceKm=3.0 km)
acceptance_criteria.when: evaluateActivity() is called
acceptance_criteria.then: Activity is rejected with rejectCode='BELOW_MIN_DISTANCE' and finalDistanceKm=0

acceptance_criteria.story: Pace Exceeding Maximum Limit with Valid Trail Elevation Gain (US-ENG-03)
acceptance_criteria.given: A trail run with distance 6.0 km, moving time 4380 seconds (pace 12:10 min/km), and elevation gain 260 m (>= trailGainMinM 100 m)
acceptance_criteria.when: evaluateActivity() is called with gainUnitM=100 and distUnitKm=1.0
acceptance_criteria.then: Activity is accepted as Trail Run with bonus = floor(260/100)*1.0 = 2.0 km and finalDistanceKm=8.0

acceptance_criteria.story: Pace Exceeding Maximum Limit without Sufficient Gain (US-ENG-04)
acceptance_criteria.given: A run with distance 4.0 km, moving time 2640 seconds (pace 11:00 min/km), and elevation gain 60 m (< 100 m)
acceptance_criteria.when: evaluateActivity() is called
acceptance_criteria.then: Activity is rejected with rejectCode='PACE_TOO_SLOW_NO_GAIN' and finalDistanceKm=0

acceptance_criteria.story: Pace Too Fast / Fraud Suspected (US-ENG-05)
acceptance_criteria.given: A run with moving time 480 seconds for 5.0 km (pace 1:36 min/km, faster than paceMin 4:00 and system floor 2:45 min/km)
acceptance_criteria.when: evaluateActivity() is called
acceptance_criteria.then: Activity is flagged with PACE_IMPLAUSIBLE and rejected

acceptance_criteria.story: Daily Activity Limit Enforcement (US-ENG-06)
acceptance_criteria.when: A 3rd activity on the same date is evaluated
acceptance_criteria.then: The 3rd activity is rejected with rejectCode='DAILY_LIMIT_EXCEEDED' and finalDistanceKm=0

acceptance_criteria.story: Overlapping Activities Detection (US-ENG-07)
acceptance_criteria.when: evaluateActivity() checks overlapping time ranges
acceptance_criteria.then: The activity is rejected with rejectCode='DUPLICATE_OVERLAP' and finalDistanceKm=0

acceptance_criteria.story: Weekly Cycle Distance Target and Penalty Calculation with Proration (US-PEN-01)
acceptance_criteria.when: calculateWeeklyPenalty() is executed with partialWeekPolicy='prorate'
acceptance_criteria.then: Penalty of 50,000 VND is assessed and appended to participant ledger; warning state triggers within 48h window

acceptance_criteria.story: Team Score Computation with Distance Ratio and Capped Diligent Days (US-SCR-01)
acceptance_criteria.when: calculateTeamScore() runs with 50/50 weights (Distance / Diligence)
acceptance_criteria.then: Rank 1 team scores highest (e.g. 18.43 pts) and pays 100k; all remaining tied teams receive Rank 2 and pay 200k

acceptance_criteria.story: Tiered Contribution and Ledger Balance Calculation (US-FIN-01)
acceptance_criteria.when: calculateParticipantLedger() is computed including accumulated weekly penalties
acceptance_criteria.then: Final individual balance equals (Tier Contribution + Sum(Penalties) - Waivers) with dynamic VietQR generation (ref <= 25 chars)

acceptance_criteria.story: Fast Acknowledgment and Event Queuing (US-WH-01)
acceptance_criteria.when: POST /api/webhooks/strava is received
acceptance_criteria.then: Server acknowledges with HTTP 200 within 200ms, logs raw sync event, and enqueues activity for async processing

acceptance_criteria.story: Manual Adjustment on Approved Appeal (US-APP-01)
acceptance_criteria.when: reviewAppeal() approves the appeal
acceptance_criteria.then: Activity log transitions to APPROVED, final credited distance is updated, and team score is recomputed

acceptance_criteria.story: Audit Trail Logging for Administrative Actions (US-AUD-01)
acceptance_criteria.given: Admin performs manual actions (approves appeal, marks payment, grants penalty waiver)
acceptance_criteria.when: The action is persisted
acceptance_criteria.then: An immutable audit log entry is written with actor_id, timestamp, entity_id, and mutation payload

acceptance_criteria.story: Admin can grant penalty waivers with valid reason

acceptance_criteria.story: Runner can self-service disconnect Strava while preserving historic race activities

acceptance_criteria.when: Runner calls DELETE /api/v1/me/strava
acceptance_criteria.then: Strava status transitions to REVOKED, new sync is blocked, all historic runs remain credited

acceptance_criteria.story: Runner can inspect raw webhook ingestion and sync logs
acceptance_criteria.given: Incoming Strava webhook activities and historical pulls

acceptance_criteria.then: System returns list of sync logs with http status, processing verdict, and raw payload details

acceptance_criteria.story: Race registration enforces 3 scopes (internal, community, designated) and max participants

acceptance_criteria.when: Runner registers for a race
acceptance_criteria.then: Internal race rejects non-club members, designated race checks whitelist, and registration auto-locks when capacity reached

acceptance_criteria.story: Race director can upload and manage athlete whitelist for designated races

acceptance_criteria.when: Admin calls POST /api/v1/races/:slug/whitelist with list of emails
acceptance_criteria.then: Whitelist entries are saved, and only listed emails can successfully join

acceptance_criteria.story: Team Captain can customize team name, avatar, and slogan with live leaderboard reflection
acceptance_criteria.given: Assigned Team Leader in a race team
acceptance_criteria.when: Leader calls PATCH /api/v1/teams/:id with new name, avatar_url, and slogan
acceptance_criteria.then: Team identity is updated and new name and avatar immediately reflect on the live arena leaderboard

acceptance_criteria.story: Athletes can send friend requests, accept, and manage 2-way friendship network

acceptance_criteria.story: Multi-Criteria Rule Engine supports customizable weights for distance, active days, gain, and pace

acceptance_criteria.when: Engine computes team standings
acceptance_criteria.then: Normalized composite scores are calculated according to configured criteria weights sum = 100%

acceptance_criteria.story: Real-time Chat with AI PacerBot and 3-Tier Banter Roast Engine
acceptance_criteria.given: Active chat channels (club, team, direct) and configured Banter engine level
acceptance_criteria.when: Runners chat or milestone triggers occur (pace near limit, rank change, <24h warning)
acceptance_criteria.then: PacerBot answers rule queries and Banter Bot delivers humorous motivation according to selected level

acceptance_criteria.story: Club Governance ERP for Disciplinary Warnings, Offline Events RSVP, and Polls
acceptance_criteria.given: Club admin managing club portal

acceptance_criteria.then: Members receive alerts, RSVP responses update live, and poll votes are tallied in real time

acceptance_criteria.story: Mantis Material UI Theme Layout & Dual-Theme Switcher (US-THM-01)
acceptance_criteria.given: OpenRace SaaS running with default sporty orange theme
acceptance_criteria.when: Runner or Admin switches theme to 'mantis'
acceptance_criteria.then: Interface activates Mantis Material UI theme: Mantis top bar with Ctrl+K search, categorized drawer sidebar, blue gradient welcome hero, 4 sparkline metric cards, spline area chart, persists in localStorage, and allows switching back to classic anytime

acceptance_criteria.story: Digital Finisher Certificate & QR Verification (US-REC-01)
acceptance_criteria.given: An athlete completed race milestones or podium team finish
acceptance_criteria.when: Runner opens their Certificate of Completion
acceptance_criteria.then: System renders authentic Certificate modal with dynamic athlete name, race title, accredited distance, rank badge, golden medal seal, verification QR code, and export options

acceptance_criteria.story: Interactive Trail Elevation Gain Profile & Anti-Cheat GPS Audit (US-ACT-05)
acceptance_criteria.given: A running or trail activity with elevation gain and track data
acceptance_criteria.when: Auditor or Runner clicks to inspect elevation audit profile
acceptance_criteria.then: System opens Elevation Profile Drawer displaying interactive topography elevation curve, trail bonus calculation steps (+2.0km), cadence verification (no vehicle fraud), and pace consistency

acceptance_criteria.story: Auto-Trim Vehicle Tail on Forgot-to-Stop Running Watch (US-ACT-06)
acceptance_criteria.given: A running activity where the runner completed a valid run (e.g. 10.0km at pace 5:30) but forgot to stop watch and drove 1.5km on motorbike (pace < 2:45 min/km, speed > 30 km/h, cadence < 110 spm)
acceptance_criteria.when: detectAndTrimVehicleTail() or POST /api/activities/:id/auto-trim is executed
acceptance_criteria.then: System detects vehicle tail segment, slices off fraudulent 1.5km, preserves genuine 10.0km run, sets autoTrimmed=true with reason 'AUTO_TRIMMED_VEHICLE_TAIL', and recalculates valid credited distance

acceptance_criteria.story: Garmin Connect & Coros API Direct Sync Ecosystem (US-DEV-01)
acceptance_criteria.given: Athletes who prefer connecting wearable devices directly without Strava intermediary
acceptance_criteria.when: Runner connects Garmin Connect or Coros via GET /api/me/connected-devices and POST /api/me/devices/connect
acceptance_criteria.then: System activates direct wearable ingestion, tracks connection status and last sync time per provider, and receives direct webhook activities

acceptance_criteria.story: Indoor Treadmill Run Validation with Continuous Heart Rate & Cadence (US-ACT-07)
acceptance_criteria.given: An indoor treadmill run without outdoor GPS tracklog
acceptance_criteria.when: Activity is submitted with sportType='TreadmillRun', avgHeartRate >= 120 bpm, and avgCadence >= 150 spm
acceptance_criteria.then: System validates cardiovascular exertion and leg turnover, certifies treadmill run as VALID, and credits distance to weekly target and team scores

acceptance_criteria.story: Standardization of 4 User Portal Groups with 28 Standard Menu Items, 4 Decoupled Club Menus & 8 Operations Menus (US-NAV-01)
acceptance_criteria.given: The OpenRace SaaS navigation ecosystem with diverse user roles (Runner, Club Captain, Platform Admin)
acceptance_criteria.when: Navigation schema is retrieved via GET /api/me/navigation-context or rendered in UI
acceptance_criteria.then: System organizes menus into 4 distinct portal groups: I. Runner Portal (5 items: Tổng Quan, Nhật Ký & Bài Chạy, Bảng Xếp Hạng, Kết Nối Thiết Bị, Quỹ & Sổ Nợ); II. Club & Team Space (8 items: 4 Decoupled Major Menus: Hồ sơ & Bảng tin CLB, Giải thi đấu nội bộ CLB, Thành viên & Cơ cấu đội, Mời TV & Chống In-App, plus Đội Của Tôi, Bảng Tin & Kudos, Trợ Lý AI, Hoạt Động & Biểu Quyết); III. Club Admin & Captain Portal (5 items: Thành Viên, Thiết Lập Giải, Kiểm Duyệt Bài, Tài Chính & Quỹ, Truyền Thông & Chốt Tuần); IV. Super Admin / Platform (10 items: 8 Decoupled Operations Major Menus + Phân Quyền (RBAC) + Tham Số Hệ Thống - Total 28 items)

acceptance_criteria.story: Top Header Context Switcher with Instant Role View Switching (US-NAV-02)
acceptance_criteria.given: A logged-in user with multiple authorized roles (Runner, Club Captain, Platform Admin)
acceptance_criteria.when: User interacts with the Top Header Role Dropdown Selector to switch views
acceptance_criteria.then: System updates active portal context, persists selection in localStorage (openrace_active_role), emits visual role badge indicator, and notifies sidebar to adjust visibility

acceptance_criteria.story: Dynamic Sidebar Filtering based on Active User Portal Role (US-NAV-03)
acceptance_criteria.given: User selecting a specific role perspective (Runner, Club Space, Club Admin, Super Admin, or All Portals)
acceptance_criteria.when: filterDynamicSidebar(role) is triggered or initial page loads with active role
acceptance_criteria.then: Sidebar displays only the relevant menu group(s) matching the active role (e.g. runner hides admin groups; captain shows Club Admin; admin shows Super Admin; all displays all 4 groups) with zero visual clutter

acceptance_criteria.story: Navigation Redirection and Functional Parity across Sport Cam and Mantis Themes (US-NAV-04)
acceptance_criteria.given: User navigating through any of the 19 menu items across both Sport Cam and Mantis Material UI themes
acceptance_criteria.when: A menu item is clicked or programmatic tab routing is called
acceptance_criteria.then: System activates the corresponding tab-content, highlights active menu items, preserves breadcrumbs, and updates mobile bottom bar or rail indicators seamlessly

acceptance_criteria.story: Backend User Navigation Context and Role Entitlements API (US-NAV-05)
acceptance_criteria.given: Authenticated athlete user requesting personalized navigation capabilities
acceptance_criteria.when: GET /api/me/navigation-context and POST /api/me/active-role are invoked
acceptance_criteria.then: System validates user permissions, returns available portal roles, current active role, and hierarchical menu permissions, and updates active role preference successfully

acceptance_criteria.story: Global Race Selector Bar & Dynamic State Re-fetch (US-RACE-01)

acceptance_criteria.story: Zone 1 - Race KPI Cards & Progress Tracking (US-RACE-02)

acceptance_criteria.story: Zone 2 - Daily Distance Analytics Bar Chart & Activity Type Distribution (US-RACE-03)

acceptance_criteria.then: System presents daily distance breakdown highlighting weekend Long Run peaks, and activity type distribution (Road %, Trail %, Treadmill %) for official referee audit

acceptance_criteria.story: Zone 3 - Live Race Leaderboards & Zone 4 - Referee Governance Queues (US-RACE-04)

acceptance_criteria.then: Presents Top 5 internal racing teams with Gold/Silver/Bronze medals and cumulative mileage, Top 10 individual breakout runners, and summary of suspicious activities flagged for referee audit

acceptance_criteria.story: Optimal UX Workflow: Ctrl+Shift+R Shortcut, Live SSE Ticker, 1-Touch Export (US-RACE-05)

acceptance_criteria.then: Quick race search modal opens instantly, SSE ticker ticks live distance progression, and GET /api/races/:id/export delivers comprehensive finisher and audit reports

acceptance_criteria.then: Sidebar displays concise standard SaaS titles (Tổng Quan, Nhật Ký & Bài Chạy, Bảng Xếp Hạng, Kết Nối Thiết Bị, Quỹ & Sổ Nợ, Câu Lạc Bộ, Đội Của Tôi, Bảng Tin & Kudos, Trợ Lý AI, Hoạt Động & Biểu Quyết, Thành Viên, Thiết Lập Giải, Kiểm Duyệt Bài, Tài Chính & Quỹ, Truyền Thông & Chốt Tuần, Giám Sát Hệ Thống, Quản Lý Tenant, Phân Quyền (RBAC), Tham Số Hệ Thống) without distracting dynamic status badges

acceptance_criteria.story: Header Role Context Switcher Multi-Persona Switching (US-NAV-V3-02)
acceptance_criteria.given: User with multiple platform personas (Athlete, Captain, Admin)
acceptance_criteria.when: User selects a persona from the header context switcher dropdown
acceptance_criteria.then: Sidebar immediately filters to that specific portal's navigation items with clear visual indicator and without page refresh

acceptance_criteria.story: Mobile Sticky Bottom Action Bar with 1-Touch Thumb Access (US-MOB-01)

acceptance_criteria.when: Bottom action bar is rendered
acceptance_criteria.then: Presents thumb-friendly 1-touch action triggers for Đồng bộ Strava, Nộp bài, Sổ nợ QR, and PacerBot AI

acceptance_criteria.story: Optimistic UI for Activity Submission and Strava Queue Sync (US-OPT-01)

acceptance_criteria.when: Submission form is executed

acceptance_criteria.story: Top-Level Full-Width Header Row for Race Selector Bar (US-RACE-BAR-02)

acceptance_criteria.description: Đóng vai trò là sổ cái thu chi minh bạch độc lập của CLB: Cấu hình tài khoản nhận quỹ tập trung (BIN, STK, Chủ TK) tích hợp sinh mã Dynamic VietQR nộp quỹ hoặc đóng phạt tuần; Danh sách sổ nợ thời gian thực tự động gắn nhãn quá hạn; Quản lý quỹ thưởng giải đấu và theo dõi giải ngân tiền thưởng sau khi Chốt Sổ & Tính Thưởng; Báo cáo tài chính, đối soát ngân hàng tự động gạch nợ tức thời và tính năng [Xuất Báo Cáo Excel] minh bạch quỹ.

acceptance_criteria.title: Phân Hệ Điều Hành Ban Cán Sự Tách Biệt & Điều Hướng Độc Lập
acceptance_criteria.description: Tái cấu trúc điều hướng phân hệ Ban Điều Hành trên Sidebar (Mantis & Classic) thành 3 menu chuyên biệt độc lập: Quản Lý Giải Đấu, Quản Lý Chuyên Môn, và Quản Lý Tài Chính; Loại bỏ triệt để các cơ chế nhảy neo chắp vá (scrollToSection hacks), đảm bảo mỗi phân hệ sở hữu màn hình và luồng thao tác riêng biệt tương ứng với từng chức trách Ban Cán Sự (Chủ Nhiệm, Trưởng Ban Chuyên Môn, Thủ Quỹ).

acceptance_criteria.title: Strava API Quota Burn Rate Forecast & Multi-App Token Rotation
acceptance_criteria.description: System calculates real-time API quota burn rate for 15-min and daily limits, forecasts time-to-ceiling, and triggers Multi-App Token Rotation or Smart Polling Backoff when usage reaches 85% threshold.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Rate limit burn rate calculation, time-to-ceiling projection, and automated token switch at >= 85% quota.

acceptance_criteria.title: Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) Data Surgery Station & Smart Exponential Retry
acceptance_criteria.description: Provides exponential backoff retry mechanism (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s) and an interactive DLQ Data Surgery Station to inspect raw payloads, edit invalid fields inline, and replay failed webhooks without database intervention.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Inspect failed webhook payload, edit malformed timestamp/data inline, and replay event back into ingestion pipeline.

acceptance_criteria.title: Multi-Tenant Health Matrix & Policy Violation Freezing
acceptance_criteria.description: Monitors tenant health indicators across all clubs (Storage used, Daily Active Runners DAU, bandwidth consumption, and SaaS subscription tiers: Free/Pro/Enterprise) with one-click temporary tenant suspension/freeze.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Retrieve multi-tenant health matrix with storage and DAU metrics, and toggle freeze status on target tenant.

acceptance_criteria.title: Scoped Recomputation Engine with Real-Time Progress & Audit Trail
acceptance_criteria.description: Enables targeted recomputation restricted to a specific tenant, race timeframe window, or malformed activity subset, displaying real-time progress percentage and logging execution to immutable audit logs.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Trigger scoped recompute for specific tenant/race, verify progress tracking stream, and check audit log entry.

acceptance_criteria.title: Real-Time Traffic Analytics, Concurrency Heatmap & Edge Network Metrics
acceptance_criteria.description: Tracks system concurrent users across race landing pages during peak hours (05:00-07:00 and 18:00-21:00) using a 24h heatmap, alongside server latency (ms), HTTP 4xx/5xx error rates, and CDN bandwidth (GB/s).
acceptance_criteria.verification: Query traffic analytics endpoints, verify 24h concurrency heatmap distribution, latency metrics, and network edge health.

acceptance_criteria.title: Ecosystem & Partner Hub, Uptime Board & API Key Scopes Management
acceptance_criteria.description: Monitors 99.9% uptime SLA across external integration partners (Strava, Garmin, Coros, Zalo OA, VietQR/Banking) with automated outage alert banners, and manages third-party developer API keys and webhook secrets with granular scopes.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Inspect 5 integration partners uptime status, simulate external outage banner, generate and revoke scoped partner API key.

acceptance_criteria.title: SaaS Business & Billing Intelligence (MRR, Churn Rate, ARPU & Revenue Streams)
acceptance_criteria.description: Aggregates platform financial metrics across multi-tenant SaaS subscriptions, race organization service fees, and community ticket sales, computing key SaaS metrics: MRR, Churn Rate %, and ARPU.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Retrieve SaaS billing intelligence metrics, verify MRR calculation, churn rate percentage, and ARPU distribution.

acceptance_criteria.title: Security Anomaly Detection & Immutable SHA-256 Audit Trail Hub
acceptance_criteria.description: Detects suspicious login anomalies (malware scans, repeated authentication failures, unauthorized treasury access) and maintains immutable, tamper-evident audit logs with actor IP and exact timestamps for all admin actions.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Log admin actions to audit trail, verify tamper-evident structure with actor IP, and report suspicious login attempts.

acceptance_criteria.title: Decoupled 8 Major Operations Menus in Mantis and Sport Sidebars
acceptance_criteria.description: Elevates the 8 operational sub-modules into independent, top-level major functional menus in both Mantis Material UI and Sport Sidebars: 1. Strava Quota & Burn Rate, 2. Webhook & Phẫu Thuật DLQ, 3. Quản Lý Tenants CLB, 4. Recompute Có Phạm Vi, 5. Lưu Lượng & Heatmap 24h, 6. Đối Tác & Uptime SLA, 7. Kinh Doanh & SaaS MRR, 8. An Ninh & Audit SHA-256 with 1-click direct tab routing.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Inspect sidebar DOM for all 8 menu entries in both themes, verify distinct icons, labels, and 1-click direct navigation triggers.

acceptance_criteria.title: Navigation Data Store Schema & Role Context with 25 Standard Items
acceptance_criteria.description: Updates InMemoryDataStore navigation groups so group-admin contains the 8 operational major menus plus IAM RBAC and Global Catalogs (10 items in group-admin, 25 items total flat menu count). Endpoint GET /api/me/navigation-context returns the 25 items with pristine metadata.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Invoke GET /api/me/navigation-context, assert 4 portal groups, group-admin with 10 items, totalMenuItems equals 25, and flat items array contains all 8 operations menu titles.

acceptance_criteria.title: Direct View Rendering & Active Highlight State for Decoupled Menus
acceptance_criteria.description: Implements switchTab aliases for all 8 operational routes (ops-quota, ops-dlq, ops-tenants, ops-recompute, ops-traffic, ops-partners, ops-billing, ops-security) to directly render their respective full views, activate correct sub-screen sections, and maintain active visual highlights on the corresponding sidebar button.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Execute switchTab for each of the 8 ops routes, assert corresponding section is rendered without manual pill clicking, and active navigation indicator matches selected menu.

acceptance_criteria.title: Decoupled 4 Club Major Menus in Mantis and Sport Sidebars
acceptance_criteria.description: Elevates the 4 club sub-modules into independent, top-level major functional menus in both Mantis Material UI and Sport Sidebars: 1. Hồ sơ & Bảng tin CLB, 2. Giải thi đấu nội bộ CLB, 3. Thành viên & Cơ cấu đội, 4. Mời TV & Chống In-App with 1-click direct tab routing (club-feed, club-races, club-members, club-invites).
acceptance_criteria.verification: Inspect sidebar DOM for all 4 decoupled club menu entries in both themes, verify distinct icons, labels, and 1-click direct navigation triggers.

acceptance_criteria.title: Navigation Data Store Schema & Role Context with 28 Standard Items
acceptance_criteria.description: Updates InMemoryDataStore navigation groups so group-club contains the 4 club major menus plus My Teams, Social Feed, AI PacerBot, and Governance Polls (8 items in group-club, 28 items total flat menu count). Endpoint GET /api/me/navigation-context returns 28 items with clean metadata.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Invoke GET /api/me/navigation-context, assert 4 portal groups, group-club with 8 items, totalMenuItems equals 28, and flat items array contains all 4 decoupled club menu titles.

acceptance_criteria.title: Direct View Rendering & Active Highlight State for Decoupled Club Menus
acceptance_criteria.description: Implements switchTab aliases for all 4 club routes (club-feed, club-races, club-members, club-invites) to directly render their respective full views in tab-club (section-4-1, section-4-2, section-4-3, section-4-4), and maintain active visual highlights on the corresponding sidebar button.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Execute switchTab for each of the 4 club routes, assert corresponding section is rendered without manual pill clicking, and active navigation indicator matches selected menu.

acceptance_criteria.title: Platform Anti-Cheat Standard vs Tournament-Specific Settings Separation
acceptance_criteria.description: Establishes a rigorous two-tier decoupling: Platform Hard Standards (Hard Anti-Cheat Floor 2:15 min/km, AI Auto-Trim Vehicle Tail, Webhook DLQ retry policy) managed globally under Platform Admin > System Parameters, vs Tournament-Specific Settings (Min Distance, Tournament Pace Gate 4:00-6:00 or 5:00-9:00, Trail Elevation Bonus +1km/100m D+, Team Ranking Formula) configured independently per race in the Wizard.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Verify GET /api/system/platform-config returns hard anti-cheat parameters (hardAntiCheatFloorPace: 2.25 min/km, autoTrimVehicleTail: true), while GET /api/races/:id/setup-config returns tournament-specific pace gates and trail multipliers.

acceptance_criteria.title: Smart Defaults & 90% Inheritance in Step 3 Race Setup Wizard
acceptance_criteria.description: Redesigns Step 3 (Quy Chuẩn Hoạt Động & Pace) of the Race Setup Wizard to visually display 90% Platform Inherited Rules (Anti-Cheat 2:15 floor, AI Auto-Trim, Wearable sync) with read-only badge guarantees, focusing tournament organizers on 3 core dynamic settings: 1. Min distance (1.0-5.0km), 2. Trail D+ elevation bonus toggle, 3. Tournament Pace Gate (Min/Max pace). Includes 1-click Smart Presets for Road Race, Trail Running, and Fun Run.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Verify Step 3 UI renders Platform Inherited badge banner, 3 core dynamic controls, and 3 Smart Preset buttons (Road, Trail, Fun Run) that populate input values in 1 click.

acceptance_criteria.title: Two-Tier Rule Evaluation Engine Execution
acceptance_criteria.description: Updates Rule Engine 2.1 to execute a two-tier evaluation pipeline: Tier 1 checks Platform Hard Anti-Cheat Floor (< 2:15 min/km) and auto-trims motor tail; Tier 2 evaluates tournament-specific rules (race min distance, race pace gate, and trail D+ elevation bonus). Enforces distinct rejection codes for platform fraud vs tournament non-eligibility.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Unit test runs with pace 2:00 min/km are rejected by Platform Floor with PACE_IMPLAUSIBLE, while runs between 2:15 and 3:59 are rejected only if tournament pace gate requires >= 4:00 min/km with TOURNAMENT_PACE_OUT_OF_BOUNDS.

acceptance_criteria.title: Eliminate Redundant Horizontal 'Chức năng:' Sub-Menu in Club Space
acceptance_criteria.description: Removes the redundant horizontal sub-navigation pill bar (Chức năng: Hồ sơ & Bảng tin CLB, Giải thi đấu nội bộ CLB, Thành viên & Cơ cấu đội, Mời TV & Chống In-App) from tab-club. Navigation between club modules is executed directly via Mantis Primary Sidebar, freeing up vertical viewport real estate.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Inspect DOM of tab-club, assert subscreen-pill horizontal bar is removed, switchTab routes for club-feed, club-races, club-members, club-invites render correct sections cleanly without runtime exceptions.

acceptance_criteria.title: Remove 'Thêm mới giải đấu / + Tạo Giải Mới' Button from Internal Club Races View
acceptance_criteria.description: Removes the '+ Tạo Giải Mới' (Thêm mới giải đấu) button (#btn-create-club-race) from the section-4-2 header in the internal club races screen. Tournament creation is strictly governed within Tournament & Category Hub (Section 7.1 / Wizard Hub), keeping the club athlete race portfolio clean, focused, and unencumbered by administrative actions.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Inspect section-4-2 header, assert #btn-create-club-race is removed from the visible UI, while filter pills (Đã Tham Gia, Đang Diễn Ra, Đã Kết Thúc, Tất Cả) and race catalog cards render intact.

acceptance_criteria.title: Activity & Pace Parameters as Tournament-Specific Settings
acceptance_criteria.description: Transfers activity parameters (MIN_DISTANCE_KM, PACE_MIN_BOUND, PACE_MAX_BOUND, TRAIL_GAIN_MIN_M, TREADMILL_MIN_HR_BPM, MAX_ACTIVITIES_PER_DAY) from static system configs into dynamic tournament-specific settings configured in Wizard Step 3 and stored in DynamicRaceSetupConfig.scoringModel. Preserves platform hard anti-cheat floors (2:15 floor and AI auto-trim) as inherited guarantees.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Verify GET /api/races/:id/setup-config returns all tournament-specific activity and pace rules, and Wizard Step 3 inputs populate with corresponding race settings.

acceptance_criteria.title: Club Payment Account Catalog & Tournament Financial Settings
acceptance_criteria.description: Establishes a Club Payment Account Catalog (Danh mục tài khoản của Câu Lạc Bộ) storing bankBin, bankName, accountNumber, and accountName. In Wizard Step 5 (Award & Financial Rules), tournament organizers select the beneficiary account directly from the Club Catalog, while configuring per-tournament financial rules: CYCLE_PENALTY_VND, CONTRIBUTION_TIER1_VND, and CONTRIBUTION_TIER_OTHER_VND.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Verify GET /api/club/bank-accounts returns club bank accounts catalog, Wizard Step 5 renders account selection dropdown with live BIN/STK/Name preview, and financial rules are saved in race setup config.

acceptance_criteria.title: Tournament-Specific VietQR Transfer Memo Prefix
acceptance_criteria.description: Allows customization of VIETQR_MEMO_PREFIX for each individual tournament (e.g. SARC, BAVITRAIL, AUTUMN26) during race setup. The dynamic VietQR generator and auto-reconciliation engine construct payment memos using the race-specific prefix ([PREFIX] + [BIB] + [PURPOSE]), ensuring automated routing and zero revenue attribution collisions between multiple active tournaments.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Verify Wizard Step 5 accepts custom VIETQR_MEMO_PREFIX, displays live preview with BIB format, and VietQR generation API produces memo matching tournament prefix.

acceptance_criteria.title: Unify Strava OAuth Connection & Webhook Logs into a Single Integrated Screen
acceptance_criteria.description: Eliminates the fragmented horizontal sub-navigation pill bar (Chức năng: [Kết Nối OAuth] [Nhật Ký Truyền Dữ Liệu Webhook]) from the Strava Sync tab (tab-strava-sync). Combines OAuth 2.0 authorization status, multi-device sync ecosystem (Garmin, Coros, Apple Watch), and real-time Webhook transmission logs (strava_sync_logs) into a single cohesive, high-information-density glassmorphic dashboard screen.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Verify that tab-strava-sync renders both OAuth connection details and Webhook event stream table on the same scrollable screen without any horizontal Chức năng pill bar, and interactions such as resync and payload inspection function seamlessly.

acceptance_criteria.title: Decouple 4 Activities Sub-Functions & Remove Horizontal Pill Bar
acceptance_criteria.description: Promotes the 4 sub-functions formerly under 'Nhật Ký & Bài Chạy' ('Toàn bộ bài chạy', 'Lọc theo giải đấu', 'Chi tiết thẩm định & Trail', 'Trung tâm khiếu nại') into independent top-level major menus in Phân Hệ Vận Động Viên (Runner Portal) on both Mantis and Sport sidebars, and completely removes the horizontal sub-navigation pill bar from tab-activities.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Verify Mantis and Sport sidebars render 'Toàn bộ bài chạy', 'Lọc theo giải đấu', 'Chi tiết thẩm định & Trail', and 'Trung tâm khiếu nại' as first-class items, and tab-activities contains no horizontal Chức năng pill bar.

acceptance_criteria.title: Decouple Personal & Finance Sub-Functions & Remove Horizontal Pill Bar
acceptance_criteria.description: Promotes the personal and financial sub-functions formerly under 'Quỹ & Sổ Nợ' ('Sổ nợ & Đóng quỹ', 'Hồ sơ cá nhân & GDPR', 'Tùy chọn giao diện') into independent top-level major menus in Phân Hệ Vận Động Viên on both Mantis and Sport sidebars, removes the horizontal sub-navigation pill bar from tab-finance, and aligns device sync directly with the unified 'Kết Nối Thiết Bị' screen.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Verify Mantis and Sport sidebars render 'Sổ nợ & Đóng quỹ', 'Hồ sơ cá nhân & GDPR', and 'Tùy chọn giao diện' as first-class items, and tab-finance contains no horizontal Chức năng pill bar.

acceptance_criteria.title: Direct Single-Click Route Activation & Active Menu Highlight
acceptance_criteria.description: Ensures 1-click execution of switchTab for each decoupled runner route ('activities-all', 'activities-filter', 'activities-inspection', 'activities-appeals', 'athlete-debt', 'athlete-profile', 'theme-preferences') directly displays the exact sub-screen container, updates breadcrumb contexts, and dynamically applies the mantis-active-nav highlight to the clicked sidebar menu item.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Verify CDP test clicks all decoupled runner items, verifying active tab, visible section, and active sidebar highlight.

acceptance_criteria.title: Dedicated Club Slogan & Mission Edit Modal with Live Preview
acceptance_criteria.description: Replaces the conflicting generic modal with a dedicated, focused modal (#modal-edit-club-slogan) accessible directly via the [✏️ Chỉnh sửa] action button on the 'KHẨU HIỆU CLB' card. Provides input fields for both Slogan (max 150 chars) and Club Mission/Description (max 300 chars), live character counters, real-time preview card, and active role permission badge.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Clicking [✏️ Chỉnh sửa] on KHẨU HIỆU CLB opens #modal-edit-club-slogan with preloaded values, real-time typing preview updates #preview-club-slogan and #preview-club-desc instantly.

acceptance_criteria.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) Enforcement for Club Slogan Modification
acceptance_criteria.description: Enforces strict permission authorization for modifying the club slogan. Only Ban Điều Hành CLB ('captain'), Quản Trị Nền Tảng ('admin'), or Full System Access ('all') have write permissions. Athletes ('runner') and unauthorized users are restricted to read-only view: the edit button reflects lock state [🔒 Chỉnh sửa] with tooltip, clicking displays an authorization warning toast ('⚠️ Bạn không có quyền thay đổi Khẩu hiệu CLB. Chỉ Ban Điều Hành CLB hoặc Quản Trị Nền Tảng mới được phép chỉnh sửa!'), and modal opening is strictly blocked.
acceptance_criteria.verification: When active role is 'runner', verify [🔒 Chỉnh sửa] is displayed and clicking it triggers the authorization warning toast without opening the modal. When switched to 'captain' or 'admin', verify [✏️ Chỉnh sửa] is active and opens the modal.

acceptance_criteria.title: Backend RBAC API Validation & Real-time DOM Profile Synchronization
acceptance_criteria.description: Provides dedicated endpoint PUT /api/club/slogan validating user role authorization. Returns HTTP 403 Forbidden with descriptive error code if invoked by 'runner' role. Upon valid submission by authorized captain/admin, updates InMemoryDataStore, reflects new slogan across #club-display-slogan, #club-display-desc, and command center widgets, and displays a success notification toast.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Test PUT /api/club/slogan with role='runner' yields HTTP 403 Forbidden. Test with role='captain' updates store, updates DOM in real-time, and yields HTTP 200 OK.

acceptance_criteria.title: Role-Based Access Control for Creating, Editing, Deleting and Pinning Announcements
acceptance_criteria.description: Restricts post publishing, updating, deleting, and pinning strictly to authorized leadership roles ('captain', 'admin', 'all'). For athletes ('runner') and unauthorized members, hides the [📝 Đăng Thông Báo Mới] creation CTA and management action buttons ([📌 Ghim], [✏️ Sửa], [🗑️ Xóa]) from announcement cards, while backend endpoints enforce HTTP 403 Forbidden on unauthorized operations.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Verify role='runner' cannot see creation CTA or [Sửa]/[Xóa]/[Ghim] buttons, and attempting backend API calls yields HTTP 403 Forbidden. When switched to 'captain', management buttons are active.

acceptance_criteria.title: Personal Hide Functionality for Runners on Club Announcements
acceptance_criteria.description: Provides an [👁️ Ẩn tin] button on each announcement card for athletes ('runner'). Clicking it hides the post immediately from the athlete's personal feed ('all', 'pinned', 'active') and stores the hidden state in local storage without affecting other members' visibility, accompanied by a toast notification informing the user they can review it under 'Đã Ẩn'.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Clicking [👁️ Ẩn tin] as runner removes the post from the current feed, updates badge count, and adds the post ID to personal hidden state.

acceptance_criteria.title: Expired & Hidden Announcements Archive Tabs with Unhide Capability
acceptance_criteria.description: Expands the filter bar with two new dedicated views: '⌛ Đã Hết Hạn' (displays past announcements whose expiresAt < today) and '👁️‍🗨️ Đã Ẩn' (displays posts hidden by the current runner). In the 'Đã Ẩn' view, cards feature an [👁️ Bỏ Ẩn] button that unhides the post, restores it to the main feed, and displays a success toast notification.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Switching to '⌛ Đã Hết Hạn' displays expired posts with badge. Switching to '👁️‍🗨️ Đã Ẩn' lists hidden posts and clicking [👁️ Bỏ Ẩn] restores the announcement to the main feed.

acceptance_criteria.title: Dedicated 'Quản Lý Hồ Sơ & Thông Tin CLB' Screen in Club Admin & Captain Portal
acceptance_criteria.description: Introduces a dedicated executive management screen (#tab-club-profile-manage) within the Club Admin & Captain Portal. Consolidates: (1) General Club Information & Slogan management with live preview and edit modal; (2) Executive Committee Management (Ban Cán Sự) with leader roster, appointment modal, and edit/delete actions; and (3) Club Announcements Management with 5 archive filters and publish/edit/delete/pin controls.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Navigate to #tab-club-profile-manage via 1-click sidebar link and verify display of Club Info & Slogan card, Ban Cán Sự roster with management actions, and Announcements feed with administrative controls.

acceptance_criteria.title: Decoupled Navigation & Sidebar Integration in Mantis UI and Classic Sport
acceptance_criteria.description: Adds 'Quản Lý Hồ Sơ & Thông Tin CLB' to Group III (Ban Điều Hành CLB) on both Mantis primary sidebar (#mantis-nav-club-profile-manage) and Classic Sport sidebar (#sidebar-club-profile-manage). Registers nav-captain-profile-manage in NavigationRoleUseCase and InMemoryDataStore with role entitlements for captain, admin, and all.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Verify sidebar item exists in Mantis and Classic Sport sidebars under Ban Điều Hành CLB. Clicking it executes switchTab('club-profile-manage') activating the tab and highlighting the navigation item.

acceptance_criteria.title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & Multi-Endpoint Backend Security Guardrails
acceptance_criteria.description: Enforces strict RBAC authorizing only 'captain', 'admin', and 'all' to access and perform mutations on club profile, slogan, executive leaders, and announcements. Athletes ('runner') cannot see this menu in the sidebar and attempts to call leader management endpoints (POST/PUT/DELETE /api/clubs/:slug/leaders) or profile update endpoints return HTTP 403 Forbidden with FORBIDDEN_INSUFFICIENT_ROLE.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Verify menu is filtered out for runner role. Calling leader mutation APIs with role=runner yields HTTP 403 Forbidden. Calling with role=captain yields HTTP 200/201.
